facts.business: Takyon Networks Limited provides end-to-end networking and IT infrastructure solutions including IT networking, data centre, IT security and surveillance, cloud and managed services, and maintenance support to government agencies and corporate enterprises.
key_risks: Rapid technological changes requiring continuous enhancement of technical capabilities and service offerings
Increasing competition from established domestic and international IT solution providers
Cybersecurity threats and evolving security requirements
Dependence on availability of skilled technical and IT professionals
Pricing pressures and changing customer requirements
Dependence on technology vendors and fluctuations in the cost and availability of technology products and equipment
Increasing regulatory and compliance requirements relating to data security, privacy and information technology
